citations.quote: all of which must be present

firstly, the services provided by the family office constitute one or more regulated activity as defined under the Ordinance; secondly, the family office is carrying on a business in the provision of such services; and thirdly, the business is carried on in Hong Kong.
should not in the ordinary course be considered as carrying on a business from a licensing perspective.

The discussion in the response to Q3 above on the types of factors required to be present in order to give rise to a licensing obligation under the Ordinance would apply equally in these circumstances.
will be primarily determined by the three key factors set out in the response to Q3.

readings.distinction: The plausible modal alternatives are (1) all three factors are necessary for an obligation and (2) their joint presence states the contextual licensing trigger. Both yield the same Boolean for this selected antecedent. Syntactically, “all of which” refers to the three factors, and the list's “and” confirms conjunction; there is no negation to reattach. Disjunction or attachment only to the third factor lacks textual support. The ordinary-course qualification concerns business classification; Q4 and Q5 do not supply a rival connective or a separate override. No substantive omitted reading of this exact target is defensible on the supplied text. One reading is retained, while broader legal sufficiency remains unresolved.

This tests the stated antecedent, not licence possession or a complete licensing verdict.

vocabulary_concerns: The Booleans cannot derive regulated-activity carve-outs or the underlying occupation, continuity, income, reimbursement and profit-purpose classifications. These require external judgment.

The vocabulary cannot express the defeasible force of “should not in the ordinary course” or competing parses of the separate business-classification guidance. Those distinctions concern how inputs are supplied, not a rival connective for the selected antecedent.
Separating business and hong_kong does not itself enforce their reference to the same business and services; that linkage is an explicit assumption.

The vocabulary cannot distinguish necessary conditions from an exhaustive sufficient legal test, represent additional incorporated requirements, or establish licence possession. Source completeness and the adequacy of this abstraction remain unverified.
